summary: Red-phase tests and OpenAPI contract-delta evidence are committed. Swift is unavailable in the container, so package resolution and the required Swift suite could not run.

references.result: The generated dependency and pinned OpenAPI document are implementation-run work.
Local URLProtocol stubs cover the five currently callable surfaces, but were not executable because swift is absent; ranked results remains an app endpoint gap.
Replacing handwritten server models is deferred to the implementation run.
The committed tests use a local URLProtocol stub and no live server, but they could not be run because swift is absent.
Concrete upstream contract deltas and the ranked-results endpoint gap are recorded for the implementation PR description; no PR was opened in this tests-only run.
